story: A 22-rider breakaway was caught after being given little room, before several new attacks followed. Xabier Isasa eventually escaped with Rui Oliveira, who bridged across from the peloton. The pair stayed clear despite a late nine-rider chase, with Isasa beating Oliveira in the sprint.
